visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand reaches toward a modern black gas stove knob and turns it, igniting a blue flame beneath a lavender-colored ceramic frying pan. The kitchen environment is brightly lit with a textured white wall background and a clean grey countertop. (2) A wooden chopstick is used to drop a small yellow cube of butter into the pan, followed immediately by a stream of olive oil poured from a light blue bottle. A yellow silicone spatula then stirs the melting fats together as they begin to sizzle and form white bubbles. (3) An egg is poured from a small white ceramic bowl into the center of the pan; the egg white turns opaque and bubbles rapidly. The cook uses the spatula to push the first egg to the side before pouring a second egg into the vacant space. (4) The cook utilizes a metal fork and the spatula to separate the eggs where they have fused at the edges, nudging them to demonstrate the non-stick surface. Both eggs are then flipped over to reveal golden-brown crispy edges. (5) The fried eggs are transferred onto two decorative ceramic plates, one pink and one orange, which are placed on a dark wooden tray. A bottle of soy sauce is used to drizzle liquid over the eggs, and finally, wooden chopsticks are used to break the yolk of one egg, showing a runny texture.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 開中小火加熱. (2) [Subtitle]: 放入一塊奶油約5~6克 適量的橄欖油. (3) [Subtitle]: 等油起泡的時候 就可以把蛋放進來煎 （維持低溫慢煎，才不會有油煙）. (4) [Subtitle]: 先推旁邊去，再放一顆蛋. (5) [Subtitle]: 先煎一下. (6) [Subtitle]: 糟糕...他們手牽手了，必須分開. (7) [Subtitle]: 推一下，確認沒有沾黏. (8) [Subtitle]: 跟不沾鍋一樣，真的不沾. (9) [Subtitle]: 好囉，翻面~. (10) [Subtitle]: 火可以轉大一點點 煎一下焦香. (11) [Subtitle]: 還是很滑...沒沾. (12) [Subtitle]: 翻面一下 已經有焦香了... 喜歡更焦，可以火再大一點. (13) [Subtitle]: 這樣就可以起囉❤️. (14) [Subtitle]: 荷包蛋❤️. (15) [Subtitle]: 用甘田醬油 沾一下❤️. (16) [Subtitle]: 好吃的荷包蛋就完成啦~❤️. (17) [Subtitle]: 裡面有蛋黃膏狀，好吃~❤️. (18) [Subtitle]: 買到鍋子的人，可以試試看~❤️.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp mechanical click of the gas stove igniter initiates the track, followed by a soft whoosh of flame. Upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic guitar music begins immediately with a bright tone and clear fingerstyle plucking. A female narrator introduces the process in a friendly and professional tone in Traditional Chinese. (2) A soft percussive thud is heard as a block of butter is dropped, followed by the distinctive glug and splashing sound of olive oil being poured into the pan. The acoustic guitar BGM remains steady, and the narrator continues her instructions with clear articulation and a moderate speech rate. (3) High-frequency scraping sounds of a spatula against the pan's surface are layered over the start of a gentle sizzling noise. Two sharp metallic taps occur as a ceramic bowl is struck against the pan rim, followed by a louder, wet sizzling sound as the cold egg hits the hot fat. (4) Rhythmic metallic scratching of a fork against the pan base is heard as the eggs are separated and pushed. The sizzling sound serves as a consistent ambient bed. The music continues its melodic progression with no pauses, and the narrator's voice maintains a light, cheerful valence. (5) A wet slapping sound is heard twice as the eggs are flipped over by the spatula, causing a brief surge in sizzling intensity and broadband noise. The BGM tempo remains consistent at approximately 115 BPM with low harmonic tension. (6) Soft, high-pitched clinks of ceramic plates being handled on a wooden surface are heard, followed by a delicate liquid trickling sound as soy sauce is drizzled. The narrator’s voice becomes slightly higher in pitch, indicating successful completion. (7) A final percussive squelching sound is heard as wooden chopsticks penetrate the crispy egg white and the soft yolk. The acoustic guitar music reaches a final cadence and fades out into a clean studio silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Preparation -> Execution -> Final Result -> Consumption
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to demonstrate the non-stick quality of a specific brand of frying pan (Le Creuset) by showing the seamless preparation of fried eggs, while simultaneously providing a simple cooking tutorial and promoting a specific brand of soy sauce.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The pan's non-stick properties are repeatedly highlighted in the text, and the soy sauce bottle is featured prominently at the end with a brand-specific call to action.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-quality studio lighting and clean audio to create a premium feel for household kitchen products.
